name: ThoughtSpot Spotter
description: From everyday data questions to high-level strategic analyses, Spotter by ThoughtSpot helps business and data teams get answers and insights they can trust, validate, and act on, enabling everyone to use data to drive the business forward.

_published_faq.name: How do I add ThoughtSpot Spotter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add ThoughtSpot Spotter to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://agent.thoughtspot.app/mcp?api-version=latest. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the ThoughtSpot Spotter MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: ThoughtSpot Spotter provides these MCP tools: check_connectivity, create_analysis_session, send_session_message, get_session_updates, and create_dashboard.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to ThoughtSpot Spotter?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to ThoughtSpot Spotter in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.

_published_faq.name: Does ThoughtSpot Spotter MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: ThoughtSpot Spotter requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
ThoughtSpot Spotter is developed by ThoughtSpot. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
